_doc: Truck profile. Every key is optional (missing keys fall back to js/trucks.js DEFAULTS). Units: metres, seconds, m/s, m/s^2. See README.md in this folder.
name: EighthMT (1:8 monster truck)

mass._doc: wheel/body = relative mass weights: raise body vs wheel for a heavier chassis / less unsprung mass. drop = metres the body mass sits below its collision spheres (lower COG, harder to flip). bodyZ = metres to shift the body mass forward(+)/back(-): moves weight distribution (more front weight = more steering grip, less wheelie). Absolute kg does not matter here: accelerations are commanded per unit mass and springs scale with weight.

suspension._doc: droop = how far (m) each axle hangs below ride height when its wheels leave the ground (visual only: wheels, axle, links and shocks extend; raise for long-travel trucks). sag = static compression, travel = extra stroke before the bump stop (m). springRate scales the spring (1 = M*g/4/sag). bound = compression damping and rebound = extension damping as a fraction of critical (rebound > bound is normal; raise rebound to stop bouncing). antiRoll couples left/right wheels. restitution = bounce off hard landings (wheels / body).

air._doc: Mid-air pitch control. throttlePitch = nose-up angular acceleration with throttle (rad/s^2), brakePitch = nose-down with brake; *Max = cap on the pitch rate (rad/s).

drive._doc: accel = launch acceleration factor, topSpeed m/s, brake* = braking decel (m/s^2) per brake upgrade level (nitro) / electric, launchBoost = extra thrust multiplier at standstill fading to 1 at launchBoostKmh.

gearing._doc: nitro = one entry per transmission level (1, 2, 3 speed). up/down = gear change speeds (m/s) 1->2, 2->3; launchMu = extra traction in 1st; g1Boost = 1st gear torque boost; fade = speed (m/s) where launch help fades out; dip = torque dip at a shift (s); pb = narrow power band (single speed).

steering._doc: max = full-lock angle in degrees at the stock steering level (steering upgrades add -1/0/+1/+2 on top; try 28-35 for a tighter turning circle); rate = response when steering (0-1 per step); returnRate = self-centring when released; speedLock = speed (m/s) where lock halves; minLock = fraction of lock kept at very high speed.

tyres._doc: grip = longitudinal (drive/brake) friction coefficient; sideGrip = lateral (cornering) friction. Raise sideGrip for more bite, lower for drifting. front*/rear* multiply per axle: lower rearSideGrip = oversteer/loose tail, lower frontSideGrip = understeer. sideGripCap = ceiling on the sideGrip gain from tyre upgrades. sideStiffness = how fast sideways slip is killed (0.5 slidey .. 1 on rails). frictionCircle = lateral and longitudinal share one grip budget (sliding while braking). bodyGrip = friction of body panels on the ground. baseGrip = reference value the upgrade multiplier is scaled from.

stability._doc: groundDamp/airDamp = per-step roll-rate damping on ground/in air (lower = more damping); antiRoll = extra roll damping when upright; wheelieDamp = pitch damping; articulation* = axle rock limit/speed; hill* = hill-climb grip and assist.

cabSpring._doc: Body/cab bounce on its mounts, one entry per shock upgrade level. wt/wr = heave and tilt frequency (Hz), ze = damping ratio (raise to reduce body bounce), roll = roll lean gain, scale = visual shock size.
